phoneAuth.intro: Register or log in with your email or phone number to continue your creation.
phoneAuth.phoneHelp: Please enter an 11-digit phone number. The +86 prefix is also supported. Format is validated only; ownership is not verified.
phoneAuth.notice: The phone number is used solely as your login account. This service does not provide SMS verification; please keep your self-set password secure. Forgotten passwords cannot be recovered, and ownership cannot be verified via SMS.
phoneAuth.passwordHelp: At least 6 characters, no need for uppercase/lowercase or symbol combinations. Supports pasting and password managers.
phoneAuth.confirmHelp: Enter the same password again to confirm it has been saved securely.
phoneAuth.mismatch: The two passwords entered do not match. Please verify and try again.
phoneAuth.invalid: Please enter a valid phone number format.
phoneAuth.passwordLong: Password is too long, please shorten it and try again (maximum 72 bytes).
phoneAuth.lockHelp: Entering the wrong password 50 consecutive times on the same account will result in a 1-hour lock. The count resets after a successful login or when the lock expires.
phoneAuth.registered: Registration successful, no SMS verification required. Enter the password you just set to log in.
phoneAuth.locked: Password entered incorrectly over 50 times, account is locked. Please try again after the current lock period ends.
phoneAuth.loginFailed: Incorrect account or password, please check and try again.
phoneAuth.alreadyRegistered: This phone number or email is already registered, please switch to log in.
phoneAuth.identityInvalid: Please enter a valid email or phone number.
